title: Towing Dispatch Estimate Worksheet
subtitle: Towing Dispatch: prices observed scope, options, and exclusions.
description: Towing Dispatch Estimate Worksheet covers disabled vehicle, requester, pickup condition, destination, tow equipment, route, custody, and delivery. The towing dispatch coordinator records Towing Dispatch observed scope, costs, options, and terms. Towing Dispatch Estimate Worksheet keeps Towing Dispatch exceptions visible until the towing dispatch coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Towing Dispatch Estimate Worksheet at roadside pickup, safe staging point, tow route, storage yard, and delivery location. Document disabled vehicle, requester, pickup condition, destination, tow equipment, route, custody, and delivery identity before Towing Dispatch begins. Compare disabled vehicle, requester, pickup condition, destination, tow equipment, route, custody, and delivery findings with stated Towing Dispatch criteria; route unresolved Towing Dispatch issues to qualified towing operations reviewer. For Towing Dispatch Estimate Worksheet, confirm requirements for Towing Dispatch. Ask qualified towing operations reviewer to review Towing Dispatch conditions beyond the towing dispatch coordinator's role.

sections.title: Customer contact, estimator, and source record
sections.guidance: For Towing Dispatch, identify responsible parties, roadside pickup, safe staging point, tow route, storage yard, and delivery location, and the linked disabled vehicle, requester, pickup condition, destination, tow equipment, route, custody, and delivery source.

fields.label: Vehicle VIN or plate, make, model, color, and location
Truck, operator, equipment, destination, and custody references

sections.title: Estimated scope, options, and pricing
sections.guidance: Capture Towing Dispatch facts for disabled vehicle, requester, pickup condition, destination, tow equipment, route, custody, and delivery; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Towing Dispatch estimate checks
items: Road, traffic, weather, visibility, and scene safety
Vehicle position, damage, mobility, drivetrain, and clearance
Tow method, attachment, securement, and special equipment
Occupant, key, property, and law-enforcement context
Departure, route, storage, and destination handoff

sections.title: Pricing evidence and next customer action
sections.guidance: Resolve open Towing Dispatch conditions; have towing dispatch coordinator assign the next Towing Dispatch owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Pricing assumptions, exclusions, and retained evidence
items: Vehicle requires different equipment or recovery plan
blocks.guidance: Pause Towing Dispatch when scene safety, authority, equipment fit, securement, destination, or vehicle custody remains unresolved. Retain the available Towing Dispatch proof and route unresolved disabled vehicle, requester, pickup condition, destination, tow equipment, route, custody, and delivery scope to towing dispatch coordinator.
